sources: recreation.gov public campsite search API for facility 233202 (one reservable group site)

values.note: $10/night for each of the 5 individual sites during the fee season (until 9/8 in 2026); free camping in the off-season, snow dependent. $5 for each additional vehicle after two. Group site (15 people) $50/night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-inez-campground (Current Conditions 'Fees until 9/8, open to free camping in off-season, snow dependent.'; Fee Site and Info '$10/night for the 5 individual sites... $5 fee for each additional vehicle after two vehicles. There is a $50 per night fee for the group site'; page last updated September 15, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The 5 individual sites are first-come, first-served with no reservations. Only the group site (up to 15 people, $50/night) is reservable on recreation.gov, from the Friday before Memorial Day to the Tuesday after Labor Day (7 consecutive nights at most).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-inez-campground ('Group Site reservations required with fee. Individual sites are first come, first serve'; 'No reservations for individual sites.'; 'This is the only site available for reservation at Lake Inez.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233202 ('The group site is the only campsite available for reservations'; 'Reservations cannot exceed 7 consecutive days.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open year-round', free and snow dependent in the off-season. recreation.gov adds that in early spring and late fall the roads are not plowed and the gate is closed.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-inez-campground (Seasons of Use 'Open year-round.'; Current Conditions 'open to free camping in off-season, snow dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233202 ('Access to the campground in the early spring and late fall is closed, roads are not plowed, gate is closed.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 5 individual sites plus 1 group site (up to 15 people). The recreation.gov catalog gives the group site a 20-ft max vehicle length; no length is published for the individual sites.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-inez-campground ('$10/night for the 5 individual sites'; 'the group site which can accommodate 15 people') + recreation.gov site search for facility 233202 (group site max vehicle length 20), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No trash collection (pack it out). Primitive, unpaved boat ramp.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-inez-campground (Restrooms 'vault toilet'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233202 ('Accessible vault toilets are provided, however drinking water and trash collection are not provided'; 'the available boat ramp is primitive and not paved'), read 2026-10-22

note: On the east shore of 314-acre Lake Inez in the Clearwater 'Chain of Lakes', Lolo NF (Seeley Lake RD), 9 mi north of Seeley Lake on the west side of MT 83, ~4,100 ft. Dense conifers limit lake views but give privacy between sites. Boating, waterskiing, fishing, paddling; volunteer hosts patrol. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Sept 15, 2026) + rec.gov: confirmed vault toilets, no potable water, 6 sites (5 individual + group); changed booking reservable true/some_sites -> individual sites FCFS only, not reservable (only the group site books on recreation.gov); added fees $10 in season with free off-season (0-10), $5 extra vehicle after two; season year-round. Rig length not published for individual sites (derived 25 ft left).
flags: Fees wording conflict on the FS page: Reservations section says 'Individual sites are first come, first serve- no fees' while Fee Site and Info says '$10/night for the 5 individual sites' and Current Conditions 'Fees until 9/8'; recorded $10 in season, free off-season.

Season: FS says 'Open year-round' (free off-season, snow dependent); recreation.gov says early spring/late fall access is closed (roads not plowed, gate closed). Recorded year_round with the caveat in season.note.
